notes.title: Ankora: Lost Days - V1.05 improvements and fixes
notes.content:
Hi there friends,

Thanks for playing Ankora, we have enjoyed your gameplays and support via steam forums, social shares, and reviews.

We have been working hard during the past few days and we have updated the game with a daily patch.
That's the things we have improved until now (v1.05):

- Added character names to the map.
- Show information about the stats in the Level up UI.
- Added navigation information to the menus.
- Fixed the Show Map button label in the Quest Detail UI.
- Some little fixes in the tutorial.
- Solved the bug with the North Portal.
- Remove some language placeholder text (please select one of the languages available from the main menu).
- Added volume slider for the music in the options menu.
- Added some extra prompts at the beginning to help with player guidance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/d2e20208455c19fd27cea3357f57c28c06cdba18.png[/img]

We are really committed to improving your experience with Ankora: Lost Days. Please, let us know your thoughts, bug reporting, and suggestion in the forum channels. 

Best regards,
Chibig team
